name: @intellectual-frontiers/estate-endpoints
description: Finds the endpoints of an estate from what describes or shows them: OpenAPI and GraphQL descriptions, Android and iOS manifests, DNS zone files, certificates and the listening ports a machine reports, as assets and links of the estate with where each came from. It reads files and text and reaches no network.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/
